title: Scoping research (next week): is anything on Hyperliquid or trade[XYZ] (Hyperliquid builder-deployed perps, e.g. XYZ100) worth trading for us?
note: OPERATOR ASK 2026-10-27 ~12:00Z (manager session session_01AFoLuJi1vLTnYv9LbP6539), verbatim: "I also want to queue up a research session for next week, like a sort of general scoping research task to see if there's anything on Hyperliquid or trading XYZ that would be worth trading." TIMING: after the weekly reset (Wed 2026-10-28 ~18Z); schedule at Thursday planning. ONE question: is there an instrument/venue there worth a Stage-0 question? Scope (desk research + public data only, no account, no keys, no orders): (1) what trades there: Hyperliquid perps/spot universe and trade[XYZ] HIP-3 markets (equity indices/single stocks, e.g. XYZ100 also seen on tradeify_1 since 2026-10-15); (2) cost stack per symbol: maker/taker fees, measured spread/depth from public book data, funding regime, oracle/mark design; (3) where it adds to what we already trade (new instruments, 24/7 equity exposure, cheaper cost than Bybit on overlapping symbols, funding-carry edges), and where it is redundant; (4) access mechanics: wallet-based auth, API/WebSocket, data history available for a backtest, regulatory/jurisdiction notes for the operator; (5) a ranked shortlist with, per candidate, the Stage-0 research/queue unit it would become (pre-registered rule, harness, cost stack) — or 'nothing worth it' with the reason. OUTPUT: one memo-free result: pre-registered queue units for the kept candidates (roadmap L-LADDER: a new venue enters through a Stage-0 question) + a one-page summary in the PR. Model Sonnet, ceiling ~$6.
